cases.assertion: A valid contact can be created through the public JSF interface.
A new browser session observes every persisted field.
An invalid email is rejected and never becomes a second row.
The independently loaded contact can be deleted.
A third browser session observes an empty durable state after deletion.

known_scope: This v1 tuple proves the Spring/H2 gold reference and the evaluator contract.
Candidate-workspace build and launch adapters are a separate gate.
MongoDB document-state equivalence is not part of this tuple.
